title: Rebooking Wait Adder on Company Reschedule Credits — Installation Jobs
content:
**Rebooking wait adder — company reschedules on Installation Jobs**

The wait adder on a company reschedule credit for an **Installation Jobs** record follows the days from the crew date Ridgeline gave up to the crew date the job is now booked for, and it is added to the credit:

| Days from the crew date given up to the crew date now booked | Wait adder |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | $40.00 |
| 4 to 14 | $15.00 |
| fewer than 4, or no crew date booked for the job yet | nothing |

The crew date given up is the crew date moved on the most recent company reschedule of the job; the crew date now booked is the booked crew date on the job record. Days are calendar days. A job with no crew date booked yet — for instance one left waiting for a new date — takes no wait adder.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Crew date given up | Crew date now booked | Days | Wait adder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 October | 5 October | 3 | nothing |
| 2 October | 6 October | 4 | $15.00 |
| 2 October | 16 October | 14 | $15.00 |
| 2 October | 17 October | 15 | $40.00 |
| 2 October | none booked yet | — | nothing |
